name: 车来了
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=车来了
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = pic1.chelaile.net.cn, api.chelaile.net.cn, atrace.chelaile.net.cn, web.chelaile.net.cn, cdn.*.chelaileapp.cn

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/pic1\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/adv\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(api|atrace)\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/adpub\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/goocity\/advert\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/atrace\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/adpub\//i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/atrace\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/exhibit\?&adv_image/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/web\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/api\/adpub\/ad/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cdn\.\w{3}\.chelaileapp\.cn\/(api\/)?adpub/i then reject(404)
